notes.title: Vote on FUTURE SENSE, our new Greenlight project!
notes.notes:
Greetings Commanders,

We've got a new project up for voting on Steam Greenlight. Future Sense is a weird and wonderful temporal adventure involving strange powers, a non-linear mystery, and a man on the run. For video, screenshots and more info, see the project page:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=524257363

Take a look and let us know what you think. If you like what you see, please vote us up and spread the word. We hope the Future Sense Greenlight campaign will be as successful as Sentinel 4: Dark Star's was. Thanks again to all of you who've supported us in the past!

Team Origin8

notes.title: Sentinel 4: Dark Star update - v1.1.0.1 now live
notes.notes:
Greetings Commanders, 

We've got a couple of small bug fixes for you today:

- The achievement for completing Campaign level 21 now fires correctly.
- Fixed a problem with selecting the final Ship and Stronghold weapons in the Armoury when all options were unlocked.

Enjoy!

Team Origin8

notes.title: Sentinel 4: Dark Star now live on Steam, 10% launch week discount
notes.notes:
Hello to all current and future Commanders!

Sentinel 4: Dark Star is now available to buy at the launch week discounted price of $6.29/£4.49/€6.29. The promotion ends on 20th August, after which it will return to its normal (but still bargain) price of $6.99/£4.99/€6.99.

We're really excited to bring the latest and greatest episode of the Sentinel series to Steam, and we hope you enjoy the game. Head over to the discussion forums to let us know what you think, or drop us a review.

Thanks to everyone who supported us on Greenlight, and to our trusty beta testers who really helped us polish up the PC release.

Team Origin8
